name: railtogether-root
description: RailTogether - Voluntary railway seat-exchange and group consolidation platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'backend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
